verdict: Yes. Trajectory from Delhi pitched car seat pillows, backrests and lumbar supports on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Car owners and drivers spend long hours on the road, and comfort products are cheap to make and easy to sell online.
angle: Memory-foam cushions and supports sell to commuters, taxi drivers and road-trippers. They're light and rarely returned. Marketplaces and car accessory shops are strong channels.
